_comment: Platforms we expect to collect every day, with a floor on daily post volume. Checked by scripts/check_collection_health.py INDEPENDENTLY of the trailing baseline, because a trailing average silently absorbs an outage: X died 2026-08-19 and by 2026-08-30 the 7-day baseline had normalized zero as normal. Changing a number here is a deliberate decision to expect less; it should never be edited to make a red build green.

degraded.tiktok: DEGRADED since 2026-08-19 — was ~400/day, now intermittent tens.
degraded.instagram: NEVER runs in CI — fetch_instagram_posts reads session cookies from a local Chrome profile, which does not exist on a GitHub runner. Works only on Jack's Mac.

recovery.bluesky_backfill: scripts/discover_bluesky.py wired 35 stale voices to verified Bluesky accounts (deterministic scoring + Haiku identity check; .gov/.edu domain handles are DNS-verified). Coverage 67% -> 79%. Rerun after adding voices; --verify-ai needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
recovery.remaining_gap: 68 voices are X-only and either absent from Bluesky, present but not posting, or have only impostor accounts (Elon Musk's best match is a jet tracker; DeSantis's is @desantisjet). These cannot be recovered for free.
recovery.x_restored: 2026-08-30: X collection RESTORED free via logged-out GraphQL with a guest token (scripts/x_guest.py) — the same mechanism Nitter used, driven directly. 25/30 sampled handles returned posts on ONE token with zero rate limiting; ~6 min for all 269. The failures are genuinely suspended or deleted accounts, not blocks. Note the earlier false conclusion: every probe was run against SenJohnThune, which is a SUSPENDED account, so 'UserUnavailable' read as 'guests are blocked'. If both GraphQL endpoints start 404ing, the query ids in x_guest.py rotated — reread them from x.com's main.*.js bundle.
